reason: A dsh Web plugin that lets users configure the running-status text shown in the chat interface, with the value persisted in user settings.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web 聊天界面提供可配置且可持久化的运行状态文案。
summaries.en: Provides a configurable and persistent running-status label for the dsh Web chat interface.

capabilities: Adds a configurable status-label setting to the dsh Web interface
Replaces the chat view's running-status text through a service or DOM injection
Persists the configured label in the user's dsh settings
